name: TP-NeuS + PE
definition: The baseline extended with positional encoding, defined as S(x, y, z) = MLP([PE(x, y, z), T(x, y, z)]).
summary: TP-NeuS + PE is a neural surface reconstruction method that augments Tri-Plane NeuS with positional encoding to improve frequency representation, differing from the full PET-NeuS by lacking modulation and self-attention components.
